result.title: Polyp Matching Using Deep Learning
result.summary: A key challenge in colon capsule endoscopy (CCE) analysis is accurately identifying whether multiple images depict the same polyp, which is critical to avoid over-counting and unnecessary clinical interventions. Additionally, this prevents prolonged follow-up colonoscopies where endoscopists search for duplicate polyps without precise localization. This study presents a novel contrastive learning-based approach to polyp matching using a Siamese neural network architecture. The model was trained on a dataset from the Danish CareForColon2015 trial. The dataset comprises 5,103 image pairs of confirmed same polyp and 5,103 pairs of different polyps, annotated by experienced clinicians. The proposed model employs ResNet variants (ResNet18, ResNet34, ResNet50), DenseNet121 and EfficientNet B0/B3 as backbones and utilizes contrastive learning with cosine vector distance metric for classification. Experimental results demonstrate high classification accuracies of up to 92% and AUC values close to 0.98. These results suggest that automated polyp matching has the potential to reduce polyp over-counting, improve patient risk stratification, and reduce unnecessary follow-up colonoscopies.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究结肠胶囊内镜中的息肉匹配问题，用 Siamese 网络配合对比学习和余弦距离，判断两张图像是否来自同一息肉，并在多个 ResNet/DenseNet/EfficientNet 骨干上报告约 92% 的分类准确率。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于医学影像的常规图像对分类应用，虽用对比学习做跨视图同一实例判别，但未涉及 VLM 的 latent 状态、推理生成或证据筛选，缺乏可供核查的具体迁移线索。
